definitions.explanation: A local tax levied on individuals based on their income and place of residence. In Japan, it is paid to the prefecture and municipality where one lives.

examples.japanese: {住民税|じゅうみんぜい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{引|ひ}かれる→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: Resident tax is deducted from my salary every month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{住民税|じゅうみんぜい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When you move, the amount of resident tax can change.

examples.japanese: {住民税|じゅうみんぜい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{前年|ぜんねん}→前年：23906_zennen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{所得|しょとく}→所得：09850_shotoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づいて→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}される→計算する：25526_keisansuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{翌年|よくねん}→翌年：23355_yokunen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{支払|しはら}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Since resident tax is calculated based on the previous year's income, you still need to pay it the year after you quit your job.

notes:
USAGE:
An important tax for anyone living and working in Japan. Unlike ⟦{所得税|しょとくぜい}→所得税：04913_shotokuzei⟧ (income tax), which is a national tax, {住民税|じゅうみんぜい} goes to local governments. It is calculated based on the previous year's income, which means new graduates or new residents may not pay it in their first year.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {住民税|じゅうみんぜい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{納|おさ}める→納める：02280_osameru⟧ (to pay resident tax)
- {住民税|じゅうみんぜい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{申告|しんこく}→申告：03687_shinkoku⟧ (resident tax declaration)
- {住民税|じゅうみんぜい}⟦{非課税|ひかぜい}→非課税：18326_hikazei⟧ (exempt from resident tax)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{所得税|しょとくぜい}→所得税：04913_shotokuzei⟧: income tax — a national tax on income
- {固定資産税|こていしさんぜい}: property tax — levied on real estate
